**C.** Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on Rainmaking's assent to the $50-per-thousand loading charge, so under UCC § 2-207(1) it is a counteroffer rather than an acceptance, and Rainmaking never accepted it. Absent conduct recognizing a contract under § 2-207(3), no contract formed, and D is wrong because § 2-207 displaces the strict mirror-image rule for goods.

CONFIDENCE: 70
